If two or more candidates have equal marks, the older candidate is ranked above the younger one. || Provisional selection list (1:1):A provisional list is prepared in the ratio of 1:1 (post:candidate) for the notified vacancies of each category, as per the reservation rules, and published on the official website. || Original document verification and medical examination:Candidates in the provisional list must appear with original documents on the date notified on the website. || Kannada language test:Candidates who did not study Kannada as a first or second language in Class 10 must pass the Kannada language test under the Karnataka Civil Services (Kannada Language Test) Rules, 1984.
